allot.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
allot.text: Ceigall India Limited has informed the Exchange about emerging as the H1 bidder in the Project नवादा जिला के पत्थर भूखण्डों की बंदोबस्ती हेतु (Allotment/Leasing of Stone Blocks in Nawada District Lot-4) (Bhadokhara, Block-D) under Competitive Bidding through E-Reverse Auction from Government of Bihar, Department of Mines and Geology on 07th September 2026
